svg.title: The four workflows of a repository and what starts them
svg.desc: Four workflows, each with what starts it. In issue-assistant.yml, a new issue, an edit or a comment starts event, which sets the labels of the form and chooses the next task; analyze lets the AI read the checkout and answer with JSON; apply checks the answer and is the only job that writes. In issue-lifecycle.yml, every morning, a merged pull request, a release and the end of a release run start sweep, which sends reminders, closes issues, closes duplicates and marks fixed issues. In labels.yml, a change of labels.toml on main starts sync-labels, which creates and updates the labels. In findings.yml, every morning, a scan on main and a change of findings.toml start findings, which dismisses the accepted findings and fails on the others.
